features.description: A user can register, log in, rotate a refresh token, and revoke a session without storing plaintext tokens.
steps: Register a user with valid credentials.
Log in and resolve the access token.
Refresh once and verify the old refresh token is rejected.
Revoke the session and verify access is rejected.

features.description: Authenticated users cannot claim, read, mutate, or delete another user's resources.
steps: Create resources for two users.
Attempt to access the first user's resource with the second identity.
Verify the request is rejected and the resource remains unchanged.

features.description: Conversation messages survive store recreation and remain scoped to their owner and session.
steps: Append user and assistant messages to a session.
Create a new store instance against the same database.
Read the session and verify ordered messages and ownership.

features.description: An interview persists questions, answers, scores, safely rendered reference answers, history, archive state, and report inputs.
steps: Create an interview and its first question.
Store a scored answer and successor question.
Render compact reference-answer Markdown as readable numbered sections, bullets, emphasis, and code without unsafe HTML.
Reload, archive, restore, and delete the interview.
Return from an active question to the populated interview history list.
Verify report aggregation uses persisted scored turns.

features.description: Weak dimensions generate owner-scoped learning tasks with deduplication and expanding review intervals.
steps: Build learning candidates from scored capability data.
Create tasks twice and verify active duplicates are not created.
Review a task and verify its count and next review time advance.

features.description: Private retrieval rejects low-relevance results and returns traceable source metadata for accepted chunks.
steps: Run the dense relevance gate for a query.
Reject results below the configured threshold.
For accepted hybrid results, retain source and score metadata.

features.description: The supervisor exposes the specialist tools and the routing evaluation reports per-agent accuracy.
steps: Build the configured supervisor.
Verify knowledge, interviewer, evaluator, and planner tools are available.
Evaluate recorded routing cases and report per-agent accuracy.

features.description: Only an administrator can list, save, delete, and enqueue ingestion for safe knowledge filenames.
steps: Authenticate as a non-admin and verify the operation is denied.
Authenticate as an administrator and save a supported filename.
List and delete the file while rejecting unsafe paths.

features.description: The primary workspace has no serious accessibility violations or horizontal overflow on supported desktop and mobile viewports.
steps: Build and start the production frontend shell.
Open the Today workspace on desktop and mobile Chromium.
Run accessibility and overflow assertions.

features.description: A product user can upload or remove an account-scoped avatar, while avatar and reminder controls remain compact, accessible, and stable at supported viewports.
steps: Open settings from the sidebar avatar.
Upload a supported image and save it as an account preference.
Reload and verify the avatar remains visible without clipping.
Toggle the daily reminder with the keyboard-accessible switch.
Verify unsupported or oversized avatar payloads are rejected.

features.description: Conversation history is managed in a searchable dedicated workspace instead of a constrained sidebar list.
steps: Open the product sidebar and verify it contains a History navigation action but no embedded conversation search.
Navigate to /history.
Search, open, rename, archive, restore, and delete owner-scoped conversations.

features.description: Product and administrator accounts use separate creation paths, browser sessions, login endpoints, and user interfaces while server-side roles remain authoritative.
steps: Create a product account through registration and an administrator through the operator script.
Verify each credential is rejected by the other login surface.
Verify the product shell exposes neither backend navigation nor service API-key settings.
Verify admin endpoints continue to require the administrator role.

features.description: A knowledge update becomes visible only after the replacement collection passes validation and can be rolled back.
steps: Build a new versioned collection without changing the serving alias.
Run structural and retrieval regression gates.
Atomically switch the alias and retain the previous version.
Verify a failed build leaves the serving collection unchanged.

features.description: Retrying or concurrently submitting the same interview answer charges and advances the turn at most once.
steps: Submit the same idempotency key concurrently.
Claim the pending turn with a conditional state transition.
Verify exactly one score and one successor turn are persisted.
Return the original result to safe retries.

features.description: Chat generation has a durable lifecycle, deterministic session ordering, safe replay, and explicit failure or disconnect recovery.
steps: Claim one active turn for a session before invoking the model.
Persist completed user and assistant messages in one transaction.
Replay a completed idempotency key without another model call.
Verify provider failure and stream cancellation release the session for retry.

features.description: The FastAPI composition root wires middleware and domain routers while DTOs and route behavior live in explicit API modules.
steps: Construct application dependencies once in the composition root.
Register domain APIRouters that do not import app.main.
Verify existing public paths remain in OpenAPI.
Enforce composition-root size and route ownership mechanically.

features.description: Synchronous SQLAlchemy transaction scripts execute through one async boundary and rely on database concurrency controls rather than process locks.
steps: Dispatch blocking application and persistence calls through one executor.
Keep each Store mutation inside one explicit engine transaction.
Keep external model calls outside database transactions.
Verify concurrent chat and interview claims without a Store business lock.

features.description: Redis jobs use atomic idempotent enqueue, owner-fenced leases, acknowledgement, retry scheduling, crash recovery, and dead lettering.
steps: Enqueue a knowledge import with an Idempotency-Key.
Claim it with an owner token and renewable lease.
Acknowledge success or schedule an exponential retry.
Recover an expired claim and dead-letter exhausted attempts.

features.description: All external chat and embedding model calls use one timeout, retry, concurrency, budget, metric, token, and safe-error policy.
steps: Construct every external model through the gateway.
Reject inputs and outputs beyond configured budgets.
Bound sync and async provider concurrency.
Record latency, errors, and provider token usage.

features.description: Chat model input retains bounded recent history plus an incrementally persisted summary of older completed messages.
steps: Reject a current request that cannot fit before claiming a turn.
Keep the newest completed messages within the configured token budget.
Persist a bounded summary and the greatest covered message ID.
Reuse the durable summary without duplicating messages on retry.

features.description: Each worktree derives an independent Compose project, resource namespace, host-port block, and Playwright port.
steps: Generate a stable safe suffix from the resolved worktree path.
Namespace Compose containers, networks, and volumes by project.
Parameterize every published host port.
Verify two worktree paths produce distinct runnable configurations.

features.description: Production Python dependencies and container images are immutable, reviewable, and mechanically checked for drift.
steps: Resolve direct Python requirements into an exact hash-verified lock.
Install the lock without dependency re-resolution in CI and images.
Pin every external image by version and manifest digest.
Reject lock drift and mutable image references in Harness checks.

features.description: Administrators can inspect a sanitized inventory and bounded live health summary for application, data, job, gateway, and observability resources without exposing infrastructure credentials or management ports.
steps: Authenticate through the separate administrator surface and open the system resource center.
Inspect live, unavailable, and disabled resource states with network-exposure labels, including Worker freshness from its bounded Redis heartbeat.
Stop or expire a Worker heartbeat and verify the resource becomes unavailable; publish a restarted instance heartbeat and verify it becomes healthy.
Verify failed probes return generic details without connection strings, credentials, internal probe URLs, or raw exceptions.
Verify non-administrators are denied and infrastructure consoles remain private unless an approved credential-free HTTP(S) link is configured.

features.description: The upgraded frontend build toolchain is lockfile-enforced and has no moderate-or-higher npm audit findings.
steps: Resolve and lock the reviewed Vite, plugin-vue, vue-tsc, and Vitest majors.
Reject toolchain lockfile regressions with an offline check.
Audit production and developer dependencies at moderate severity.
Pass type, unit, production build, bundle, and browser gates.

features.description: Administrators can correlate authoritative user activity, canonical user-input/system-output interactions, and sanitized execution traces without copying interaction content into generic logs.
steps: Perform authenticated API actions and verify actor, action, request ID, target, outcome, status, and duration are recorded server-side.
Open the administrator audit center and filter recent activity by user, action text, outcome, target, or request ID.
Inspect canonical chat and interview records and verify exact persisted user input and system output are displayed.
Open an interaction timeline and correlate agent or assessment execution and tool calls by interaction and request ID.
Verify administrator content reads are audited and audit/trace details redact credentials and content-shaped fields.

features.description: Administrators can inspect a reverse-chronological, deployment-authored ledger of recent Canary and production releases without treating unshipped Git commits as releases.
steps: Record a stable release ID when deployment starts and reuse it when the deployment reaches a terminal outcome.
Attach sanitized change, image, migration, recovery-point, and verification summaries after deployment checks.
Authenticate through the administrator surface and open the release timeline.
Filter releases and inspect the accessible detail drawer on desktop and mobile.
Verify product users cannot access the administrator release API.
